events: source gains or loses static ability
source enters or leaves applicable zone
state_writes: continuous permissions, restrictions, prevention, and replacement results
timing: cast/play permission from a nonbattlefield zone
targets: an attachment's static effect applies without targeting its attached object
hidden_information: static permissions in private zones expose only the entitled player's card
replacement_effects: static replacement and prevention effects are active only in their applicable source zones
copy: copied and text-changed characteristic-defining abilities use their acquired provenance
control_change: controller-relative static effects re-evaluate from current control
zone_change: battlefield static effects stop when the source leaves
characteristic-defining abilities persist in all zones
source_leaves: static abilities use current information rather than source last-known information

implementation.component: CommanderEngine effective-characteristic, attachment, cost, and zone-permission paths

known_blockers: static Oracle text is not compiled into one generic continuous-effect model
characteristic-defining ability recognition and all-zone evaluation are incomplete
Aura, Equipment, and Fortification modifiers use a narrow grammar plus exact handlers
stack-applicable costs and permissions do not cover the complete Oracle grammar
nonbattlefield cast/play permissions cover selected trusted templates only
static-effect current-information versus LKI is not represented by a universal typed query boundary
